english: Well then, I disagree with the second part of your reason before: I disagree that qualities are characteristic of that which is neither a quality of nor characteristic of that which is neither a quality of nor characteristic of knowable things. Suppose you do disagree. In that case, let's again consider qualities. They are so characteristic of that which is neither a quality of nor characteristic of that which is neither a quality of nor characteristic of knowable things, Because (1) they are something which is neither a quality of nor characteristic of that which is neither a quality of nor characteristic of knowable things; (2) they are related to that which is neither a quality of nor characteristic of that which is neither a quality of nor characteristic of knowable things, in such a way that to be them is to be it; and (3) there are many examples of things which are not them, but which are still neither a quality of nor characteristic of that which is neither a quality of nor characteristic of knowable things.
